q: Under double-entry bookkeeping, each transaction affects at least ___.
explanation: Every transaction has debit and credit effects recorded in at least two accounts.
Assets are financed by capital and liabilities.

q: A document acknowledging cash received is a ___.
explanation: A receipt confirms that payment has been received.

q: An increase in an asset account is normally recorded on the ___ side.
explanation: Asset increases are debited under the usual double-entry rules.

q: A trial balance is prepared mainly to check the arithmetical agreement of ___.
explanation: The trial balance compares debit and credit balances extracted from the ledger.
